# 🧠 Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Assistant

A distributed multi-agent AI system for autonomous research and document retrieval,
built with **FastAPI**, **ChromaDB**, **RAG pipelines**, and **Claude** (Anthropic).

---

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Frontend (HTML/CSS/JS)              │
│  Document Upload │ Research Input │ Agent Activity    │
└───────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                        │ WebSocket + REST
┌───────────────────────▼──────────────────────────────┐
│                   FastAPI Backend                     │
│                                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐     │
│  │          Orchestrator Agent                  │     │
│  │  ┌───────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌────────────┐  │     │
│  │  │  Planner  │ │Retrieval │ │ Synthesis  │  │     │
│  │  │  Agent    │ │  Agent   │ │   Agent    │  │     │
│  │  └───────────┘ └──────────┘ └────────────┘  │     │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
│                                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐     │
│  │           RAG Pipeline                       │     │
│  │  Document Processor → Chunker → ChromaDB    │     │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────┘     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Agents
| Agent | Role |
|---|---|
| **Orchestrator** | Coordinates the full research workflow |
| **Research Planner** | Decomposes query into 2–4 sub-questions |
| **Retrieval Agent** | Queries ChromaDB and analyses results with LLM |
| **Synthesis Agent** | Combines all findings into a coherent report |

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.9+
- An [Anthropic API key](https://console.anthropic.com/)

### 1 — Clone / Extract
```bash
cd research_assistant
```

### 2 — Set up the backend

```bash
cd backend

# Create a virtual environment (recommended)
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate        # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 3 — Configure environment
```bash
# Copy the example and fill in your key
cp ../.env.example .env
# Edit .env and replace sk-ant-YOUR_KEY_HERE with your real key
```

### 4 — Run the backend
```bash
python main.py
# Server starts at http://localhost:8000
# API docs at   http://localhost:8000/docs
```

### 5 — Open the frontend
Simply open `frontend/index.html` in your browser (double-click or drag into Chrome/Firefox).

> **Note:** No build step needed — it's plain HTML + CSS + JS.

---

## 📖 Usage

1. **Upload documents** — drag & drop PDF, TXT, MD, DOCX, or CSV files into the left sidebar.
2. **Ask a question** — type your research query in the input box.
3. **Watch agents work** — the right panel shows real-time agent activity.
4. **Get your answer** — a structured markdown report is rendered with source citations.

---

## 📁 Project Structure

```
research_assistant/
├── backend/
│   ├── main.py                  # FastAPI app entry point
│   ├── config.py                # Configuration & env vars
│   ├── requirements.txt
│   ├── agents/
│   │   ├── base_agent.py        # Shared LLM client
│   │   ├── orchestrator.py      # Workflow coordinator
│   │   ├── planner_agent.py     # Query decomposition
│   │   ├── retrieval_agent.py   # Vector search + analysis
│   │   └── synthesis_agent.py   # Final report generation
│   ├── rag/
│   │   ├── document_processor.py # File parsing & chunking
│   │   └── vector_store.py       # ChromaDB wrapper
│   └── models/
│       └── schemas.py            # Pydantic models
├── frontend/
│   ├── index.html               # Single-page app
│   ├── css/styles.css           # Dark theme UI
│   └── js/app.js                # WebSocket + REST client
├── .env.example
└── README.md
```

---

## 🌐 API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/health` | Health check |
| `POST` | `/upload` | Upload a document |
| `GET` | `/documents` | List all documents |
| `DELETE` | `/documents/{id}` | Delete a document |
| `POST` | `/research/start` | Get a task ID |
| `GET` | `/tasks/{id}` | Fetch completed task |
| `WS` | `/ws/{task_id}` | Real-time research stream |

Interactive docs: **http://localhost:8000/docs**

---

## 🔧 Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | *(required)* | Your Anthropic key |
| `CHROMA_PERSIST_DIR` | `./chroma_db` | ChromaDB storage path |

---

## 💡 Tips

- **Larger documents** — increase `CHUNK_SIZE` in `config.py` for better context.
- **More sources** — use the "Max sources" dropdown before querying.
- **Multiple docs** — upload several related documents; the system searches across all of them.
- **Best results** — use specific, focused research questions rather than very broad ones.
